newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bank watchdog raided in KB probe.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bank watchdog raided in KB probe.

text.p: Belgium's financial sector watchdog, the Banking and Finance Commission, said on Thursday police had seized documents from its headquarters in connection with an inquiry into Belgian bank Kredietbank and its majority owned Credit General unit.
"The CBF communicates that documents have been seized from its offices in the framework of a judicial inquiry opened about Kredietbank and Credit General," the CBF said.
The Banking and Finance Commission said it had not helped the police in their inquiries. The investigating magistrate that oversaw the operation "himself selected the documents seized," it said.
The CBF gave no other details.

Judicial authorities raided the offices of Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt earlier this year after allegations he or some of his staff intervened in a tax dispute settlement negotiated with KB.
It was not immediately clear if the two raids were related.
